name: Healing
overview: Scripture reveals that healing is a divine act from the LORD who promises to protect and restore His people when they obey His commandments, as seen in Exodus 15:26 where God declares Himself as the healer. The psalmist affirms that God not only heals physical ailments but also restores the soul and delivers the righteous from their troubles and afflictions (Psalms 23:3; 30:2; 34:17,19). Healing, therefore, is intimately connected with God's faithful care and righteousness, underscoring the believer's trust in Him as the ultimate source of restoration and deliverance.
